description: A compile-time boolean EXPRESSION (one with a B-AND / B-OR / B-XOR / B-NOT / B-SHIFT-* operator, or a parenthesized boolean literal) as the operand of a >>DEFINE directive - a COBOL-2023 addition. The 2002 and 2014 DEFINE general formats (§2002:7.2.9.1, §2014:7.3.9.1) admit arithmetic-expression-1, literal-1 or PARAMETER (and OFF); only the 2023 general format (§2023:7.3.11.2) adds boolean-expression-1, with its own syntax rule (§2023:7.3.11.3 SR4) and general rule (§2023:7.3.11.4 GR7). A compile-time boolean expression is still admitted in an EVALUATE directive and a constant conditional expression below 2023 (§2002:7.2.6), so the gate is asked at the DEFINE operand only; a boolean LITERAL (B"1111") is literal-1 and is admitted in every edition. The directive is refused (it defines nothing) below 2023, through the ONE ConstructRegistry funnel, by ConditionalCompilationProcessor.ApplyDefine (kb/Work PB5601).
display: a boolean expression as the >>DEFINE operand
citation: ISO §2023:7.3.11.2 general format, §2023:7.3.11.3 SR4, §2023:7.3.11.4 GR7 (boolean-expression-1 added to the DEFINE format; absent from §2002:7.2.9.1 and §2014:7.3.9.1)
source:
>>DEFINE V AS B"1100" B-OR B"0011"
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PB5601DB.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY "X".
           STOP RUN.
